title: How to list all Claude Code chat histories across all projects on a computer?
question: I use Claude Code CLI ( @anthropic-ai/claude-code ) across many different projects on my local machine. Depending on the project, I might spin it up via the built-in terminal inside Cursor IDE, or directly through standard shells like PowerShell and bash, or somewhere else (VS Code, JetBrains, etc.). Since Claude Code seems to keep track of previous interactions, I would like to know if there is a way to see a unified list of all the chats/sessions I've had across all projects on my computer. How to list all Claude Code chat histories across all projects on a computer?
answer: How to list all Claude Code chat histories across all projects on a computer? To clarify the terms, Claude Code views each folder as a project, and within a project, each each session is saved as a jsonl file. Therefore, in the Claude Code logs, sessions are grouped by projects. 1 session = 1 jsonl file (the file name is a UUID Version 4, I believe entirely randomly generated).
